rules.source: Ley N° 7593/2025 de Protección de Datos Personales en la República del Paraguay — https://www.bacn.gov.py/leyes-paraguayas/12924/ley-n-7593
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary (official BACN page listed but not opened; details from secondary press): general framework for public and private processors, creates the Agencia Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales within MITIC; promulgated 27-28 November 2025; sources disagree on which provisions are already operative (regulation due within 24 months, full implementation ~November 2027).

rules.source: Ley N° 1334/98 de Defensa del Consumidor y del Usuario (amended by Ley 6366/2019) — https://www.bcp.gov.py/marco-legal
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary of the Banco Central del Paraguay legal-framework page: lists Ley 1334 as the consumer and user protection law; Ley 6366 of 2019 amends it to clarify information on credit operations.

rules.source: Ley N° 6534/2020 de Protección de Datos Personales Crediticios — https://www.bcp.gov.py/marco-legal
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: BCP lists Ley 6534/2020 on credit personal data; a 2023 BCP resolution regulates licensing, supervision and sanction of credit information bureaus; the law sets a 5-year retention period for credit data (per a Ferrere analysis).
